name: media-source
description: Virtual camera + microphone. Plays a video file into the voice & gaze pipelines in sync — the whole perception stack behaves exactly as with live devices. One UI, one file, one Play button; also drivable over the bus (media.play / media.stop) for scripted demos.

media.play.description: Play a video file as camera + mic. Payload: {file: absolute path, loop?: boolean, audible?: boolean}. Warms both perception servers first so playback starts in sync.

file.description: Absolute path of the video file on the host running the perception servers.

loop.description: Rewind the video at EOF instead of holding the last frame (gaze side).

audible.description: Also play the audio through the host's speakers so a human (or screen recording) hears the replay.

media.stop.description: Stop playback on both servers and return them to idle.

media.status.request.description: Ask for an immediate media.status snapshot.

media.browse.description: List a directory on the host running the node (directories + video files only), for picking a file to play. Answers on media.files.

dir.description: Absolute directory to list. Omit or empty for the host's home directory.

req.description: Opaque request token echoed back in media.files, so a caller can match its answer.

media.status.description: Playback state: {state: idle|warming|playing|ended|error, file, loop, voice: {...}, gaze: {...}}. Published on transitions and on request.

media.files.description: Answer to media.browse: {req, dir, parent, entries: [{name, path, kind: dir|file}], error}.
